queries.core_p131: SELECT ?item ?coord ?sl WHERE { ?item wdt:P131+ wd:Q72 ; wdt:P625 ?coord ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl }
queries.labels: SELECT ?item ?l WHERE { VALUES ?item { %VALS% } ?item rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(LANG(?l) IN ("de", "en", "ru", "fr", "it")) }
queries.descriptions: SELECT ?item ?d WHERE { VALUES ?item { %VALS% } ?item schema:description ?d . FILTER(LANG(?d) IN ("de", "en", "ru", "fr", "it")) }
queries.aliases: SELECT ?item ?a WHERE { VALUES ?item { %VALS% } ?item skos:altLabel ?a . FILTER(LANG(?a) IN ("de", "en")) }
